verdict.rationale: The evidence never shows Companies House forms or their instructions being downloadable without an account. The only mention of forms is the reference to filing online "instead of posting a paper form" (companies-house-docs-17), which implies paper forms exist but does not document that they can be downloaded. The keyless GOV.UK content API probe covers generic host-platform guidance ('set-up-business'), not Companies House forms, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account
